title: Opus Eponymous
producer: Credited to a band member under an alias
studio_context: A few weeks in a basement studio in Linköping (Manfire Recordings, White Light Studio), for a 'Seventies vibe'; mixed and mastered by Jaime Gómez Arellano.

drum_performances.name: The Nameless Ghoul on drums
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The first record and the songs the live set still opens and closes on: Ritual's ride groove with the kick in 3+3+2, and Con Clavi Con Dio's fast waltz in 6/8. The studio drums are credited to a session player, not to the ghoul (the credit's name is not stored: the drummer's chair is private); the record stands for the parts the drumming ghoul plays live.

evidence.note: The ghoul's own part on the record is not credited; the grooves are from human tabs.

notable_moments.description: Con Clavi Con Dio and Genesis are 'sped-up waltzes'; the tab writes Con Clavi Con Dio in 6/8 throughout.
